title: Restore a trashed Gmail message with AI
h1: bring a gmail message out of trash
description: Recover a Gmail message from trash by asking a bot to find and restore the exact email. Learn which reference it needs and what recovery cannot promise.
keyword: gmail restore trashed email with ai
answer: **bring back the email you meant to keep.** tell the bot which gmail account, who sent it and roughly when. it finds the message in trash and restores the match you choose. restoration needs write access and does not automatically pause. ask to see the subject and date first so a familiar title does not pick the wrong email.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: recover the email you meant to keep.
what:
**you emptied a newsletter folder and took the flight confirmation with it.** the bot can search trash and restore that message. give it the account, sender, date or subject so it can separate similar results.

restoring removes the email from trash. this action has no destination-folder choice, so you may still need to find where gmail put it.

permanently deleted mail is beyond this action’s reach.
uses: **rescue a travel confirmation.** get it back before checking the ticket number.
**undo a bad cleanup.** restore the customer approval you still need.
**find proof of purchase.** recover the warranty email before a repair visit.

routine.message: find the email from claire@ledgerly.example i deleted last week, show me the subject and date, and restore it when i say yes. use my work gmail account. restore only that message. never empty trash or restore other mail.
routine.when: once, when you ask to recover the email
routine.needs: gmail connected with read and write to restore messages
routine.output:
1 match in work gmail trash
from: claire@ledgerly.example
subject: your q3 return is ready to sign
date: 5 november 2026

restore this message?

steps: **name the account.** label your gmail connection so the bot searches the right mailbox.
**find before restoring.** read only can find the message; restoration needs read and write.
**choose the match.** read its sender, subject and date, then say yes to that email.
**open gmail afterwards.** confirm the message has left trash and find its new location.
watch: **permanently deleted mail cannot come back here.** search trash before asking this action to restore it.
**work and personal trash are different places.** name the account in the request.

faq.q: does restore always put the message in my inbox?
faq.a: **no destination choice comes with this action.** it removes the email from trash. look for it in gmail afterwards.

faq.q: can it recover every message from a conversation at once?
faq.a: **this action restores one message. the untrash thread action restores the whole conversation.** ask for the list first either way.

steps: ask to see its subject and date first
restore that match and find it in gmail

mistakes.fix: compare sender and date too. similar subjects can hide different messages.
restore first, then ask separately if you need the email moved.

tip.text: searching trash can stay read only until you have found the email you want.
